title: Library Management System (LMS) — Software Requirements Specification
source: Synthetic Library Management System SRS (40 requirements)

requirements.text: A Librarian shall create a new Member account only after verifying the applicant's government-issued photo ID and recording full name, email address, and phone number; if verification fails, the Circulation System shall reject account creation and log reason code ERR-ID-01.

The Authentication Service shall enforce Member passwords of at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters; passwords failing validation shall be rejected with HTTP 400.
The Authentication Service shall hash all Member and Librarian passwords using bcrypt with a cost factor of 12 before database storage, and shall never store or log plaintext passwords.
The Authentication Service shall terminate an authenticated web portal session after 15 minutes of user inactivity and redirect the user to the login page with status message SESSION_EXPIRED.
The Authentication Service shall lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window.
When a Librarian links a Member account to a Guarantor profile, the Notification Service shall notify him by email within 60 seconds and log delivery status.
The Authentication Service shall expire password-reset tokens TBD minutes after issuance and invalidate any unused token upon a subsequent reset request.
The Portal Interface shall provide a user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections.

The Circulation System shall allow an active Member in good standing to have at most 5 physical items checked out simultaneously; any checkout exceeding 5 items shall be blocked with error ERR-LOAN-LIMIT.
The Circulation System shall assign a standard loan duration of 14 calendar days from the checkout timestamp for all circulating print books.

The Circulation System shall hold a reserved item on the pickup shelf for exactly 72 hours after sending the pickup-ready notice; if uncollected after 72 hours, the system shall cancel the hold and notify the next Member in queue.

The Circulation System shall allow a Member to renew an eligible loan at most TBD consecutive times provided no other Member has an active hold on that title; ineligible renewals shall return error ERR-RENEW-DENIED.
When a Member scans an item barcode at a self-checkout kiosk, the Circulation System shall validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt.
The Hold Queue Service shall restrict each Member to the allowed maximum number of active hold requests and reject additional requests with message ERR-HOLD-CAP.
The Circulation System shall allow a standard Member in good standing to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously through the desk or self-checkout terminal.
The Circulation System shall set the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp.
Unverified visitors shall be able to self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification.
Reserved items placed on the pickup shelf shall remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold.
The Billing Service shall assess an overdue fine of $0.50 USD per overdue day per item, capped at a maximum of $20.00 USD per item, starting 24 hours after the due timestamp.
The Circulation System shall block any Member with an unpaid fine balance exceeding $5.00 USD from borrowing or renewing items until the balance drops to $5.00 USD or below.
When an item becomes 7 days overdue, the Notification Service shall send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag.
Overdue fine waiver requests up to $25.00 USD shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded with a reason code in the audit log within 1 business day.
The Notification Service shall dispatch SMS due-date alerts to Members before the due date if appropriate.
The Billing Service shall retain payment receipts for TBD years before purging them from archival storage.
The Billing Service shall charge an overdue fine of $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines.
A Member shall be permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance.
The Circulation System shall display each Patron's active loan count and enforce the 5-item borrowing limit on the Patron profile screen within 1 second.
The Catalog Search Service shall return search results quickly even when many users are querying the catalog simultaneously.
The Catalog Search Service shall highlight matched query terms inside result snippets where possible.
The Catalog Search Service shall provide sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times for catalog lookups.
The Catalog Import Service shall efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown.
When a Librarian attempts to delete a bibliographic record that still has active loans or holds, the Catalog Service shall detect the active references.
The Reporting Service shall allow an Administrator to export daily circulation logs in UTF-8 CSV format up to 100,000 rows per file, returning status HTTP 200 within 10 seconds.
The Backup Service shall execute an encrypted full database backup at TBD intervals and verify checksum integrity; backup failures shall trigger an alert to the Administrator within 5 minutes.
The Audit Service shall record important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period.
If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01.
The Portal Interface shall provide adequate transport security and clear error messages during authentication.
The Authentication Service shall accept any Member password of at least 8 characters during account registration and password reset.
The Authentication Service shall keep authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity before requiring re-authentication.
The Authentication Service shall encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords upon request.
